questions.question: What is the sum of the digits of the least number which when divided by 12, 16 and 20 leaves the same remainder 6 in each case and it is divisible by 9?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

The divisibility rule of 9: The sum of digits should be divisible by 9.

By using the divisibility rule of 9, in the given options, only Option (2) satisfies the divisibility of 9.

So the correct answer is 18.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A number when divided by 12, 16 and 20 leaves remainder 6

The number is divisible by 9

**Concept used:**

The divisibility rule of 9: The sum of digits should be divisible by 9

**Calculation:**

LCM(12, 16, 20) = 240

⇒ The required number is (240k + 6)

⇒ (240k + 6) is divisible by 9

By hit and trial method, k = 2

⇒ (240 × 2) + 6 = 480 + 6 = 486

Thus, the required number is 486

**∴ The sum of the digits of 486 is 18.**

questions.question: The average age of 10 members of a family is 29 years. If the youngest members are twins and each is 5 years old, what was the average age (in years) of the family members at the time of birth of the twins?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average age of 10 members of a family is 29 years

**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of all Observations)/(Total Number of Observations)

**Calculation:**

The average age of 10 members of a family is 29 years

⇒ Sum of ages of all family members = 10 × 29 = 290

The youngest members are twins and each is 5 years old

⇒ Sum of ages of the remaining members = 290 – (10 × 5)

⇒ Sum of ages of the remaining members = 290 – 50 = 240

The average age of family members at the time of birth of twins

⇒ 240/8 = 30 years

**∴ The average age of family members at the time of birth of twins is 30 years.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 10,000 amounts to Rs. 13,225 in 2 years at a certain rate percent per annum, when the interest is compounded annually. What will be the interest (in Rs.) on the same sum for the same time at the same rate, when the interest is compounded 8-monthly?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum = 10000

Amount = 13225

Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1+ (r)/(100))ⁿt

Where, A = Amount, P = Principal, r = Rate, t = Time

n = Number of times interest is compounded annually

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Interest is compounded annually

⇒ 13225 = 10000 × {((100 + r)/(100))²}

⇒ 1.3225 = {((100 + r)/(100))²} 

⇒ ​sqrt{1.3225} = {(100 + r)/(100)}​

⇒ 1.15 × 100 = 100 + r

⇒ r = 15%

Again, according to the question,

Interest is compounded 8 monthly

⇒ n = 12/8 = 3/2

⇒ r = large{(15×8)/(12)} = 10%

A = 10000 × {(1 + (10)/(100))⁽⁽³⁾/⁽²⁾times ²⁾}

⇒ A = 10000 × {(1 + (10)/(100))³}

⇒ A = 10000 × (110)/(100) × (110)/(100) × (110)/(100) = 13310

CI = 13310 - 10000 = 3310

**∴ The interest on 10000 for 2 years at the rate of 15%, interest compounded 8 monthly will be Rs 3310.**

questions.question: A train, 250 m long, passes a railway platform 200 m long, in 45 s with a uniform speed. What is the time (in seconds) taken by the train to pass a man cycling in the direction of the train at a speed of 6 km/h?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed of train = Total Distance ÷ Time = (250 + 200) ÷ 45 = 10 m/s.

Speed of man = 6 × (5 ÷ 18) = 5/3 m/s.

Relative speed in same direction = 10 − 5/3 = 25/3 m/s.

Time to pass the man = Train Length ÷ Relative Speed = 250 ÷ (25/3).

Time = 250 × (3 ÷ 25) = 30 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Length of train = 250 m

Length of platform = 200 m

Time taken to cross platform = 45 s

Speed of man = 6 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Relative Speed (Same Direction) = Speed of Train − Speed of Object

Time to cross a moving object = Train Length ÷ Relative Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total distance covered to cross the platform = Length of train + Length of platform

⇒ Total distance = 250 + 200 = 450 m

⇒ Speed of train = 450 ÷ 45 = 10 m/s

⇒ Speed of man in m/s = 6 × (5 ÷ 18) = 5/3 m/s

⇒ Relative speed = 10 − 5/3 = (30 − 5) ÷ 3 = 25/3 m/s

⇒ Time taken to cross the man = Length of train ÷ Relative speed

⇒ Time = 250 ÷ (25/3) = (250 × 3) ÷ 25

⇒ Time = 10 × 3 = 30 s

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, Relative Speed = S₁ − S₂. When they move in opposite directions, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.

Unit Conversion

questions.question: A machine can complete double the work that a man can complete in a given period of time. To complete a work, 10 machines and 5 men take 60 days. If there were 10 men and 5 machines, then the time it would have taken to complete the work is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of efficiency of machine and man is 2 : 1

Formula:

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Total Work = (10 machine + 5 men) × 60

⇒ Total Work = (10 × 2 + 5 × 1) × 60

⇒ Total Work = 25 × 60 = 1500 units

Efficiency of 10 men and 5 machines = (10 × 1) + (5 × 2)

⇒ Efficiency of 10 men and 5 machines = 20 units

Time taken by 10 men and 5 machines to complete the work

⇒ 1500/20 = 75 days

**∴ The time taken by 10 men and 5 machines to complete the work is 75 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick __**Ratio of efficiency of machine and man is 2 : 1

⇒ (10 Mach + 5 Men ) × 60 = (5 Mach + 10 Men ) × D

⇒ (10 × 2 + 5 × 1) × 60 = (5 × 2 + 10 × 1) × D

⇒ 25 × 60 = 20 × D

⇒ Number of days required = (25 × 60)/20 = 75 days 

∴ The time taken by 10 men and 5 machines to complete the work is 75 days.

questions.question: The radius of the base of a solid right circular cylinder is 10.5 cm and its volume is 5197.5 cm³. What is the total surface area (in cm²) of the cylinder? (Take π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of cylinder = 10.5 cm

Volume of cylinder = 5197.5 cm³

**Formula Used:**

**1**. Volume of Cylinder = πR²h

**2**. Total Surface Area of Cylinder = 2πR(R + h)

Where, R = Radius, h = Height

**Calculation:**

According to the question

5197.5 = 22/7 × 10.5 × 10.5 × h

⇒ h = (495 × 7)/(22 × 10.5)

⇒ h = 15 cm

Total Surface Area of Cylinder = 2 × 22/7 × 10.5 (10.5 + 15)

⇒ Total Surface Area of Cylinder = 2 × 22/7 × 10.5 × 25.5 

⇒ Total Surface Area of Cylinder = 25.5 × 1.5 × 44

⇒ Total Surface Area of Cylinder = 1683 cm²

**∴ The total surface area of the cylinder is 1683 cm2.**

questions.question: The average speed of a train is 180% of the average speed of a car. The car covers a distance of 990 km in 15 hours. The time taken (in hours) by the train to cover the distance of 891 km is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Speed of the car = 990 ÷ 15 = 66 km/h.

Speed of the train = 180% of 66 = 1.8 × 66 = 118.8 km/h.

Time taken by train = Distance ÷ Speed = 891 ÷ 118.8 = 7.5 hours.

7.5 hours is equal to 7½ hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 7½ hours.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance covered by car = 990 km

Time taken by car = 15 hours

Average speed of train = 180% of average speed of car

Distance to be covered by train = 891 km

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/997a032947ac6296bc625af177cb2339ba94cdd8a414c754a66448bf399ad6a5.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed of the car = 990 ÷ 15

⇒ Speed of the car = 66 km/h

⇒ Speed of the train = 180% of 66

⇒ Speed of the train = (180 ÷ 100) × 66 = 1.8 × 66 = 118.8 km/h

⇒ Time taken by the train = 891 ÷ 118.8

⇒ Time taken by the train = 8910 ÷ 1188

⇒ Time taken by the train = 7.5 hours

⇒ 7.5 hours = 7½ hours

**∴ The correct answer is 7½ hours.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Average speed is the total distance traveled divided by the total time taken. Formula: Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds (S₁ − S₂). In opposite directions, it is the sum (S₁ + S₂).

Conversion of Units

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5 ÷ 18. To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.

questions.question: When 'x' is subtracted from each of the numbers 22, 39, 56 and 107, then the resulting numbers, in this order, are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (x + 3) and (3x - 7)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

'x' is subtracted from each of 22, 39, 56, and 107 then the numbers obtained are in proportion

**Formula used:**

**1**. When four numbers a, b, c, and d are in proportion

a/b = c/d or ad = bc

**2**. Mean proportion of a and b = sqrt{ab} 

**Calculation:**

According to the question

(22 - x), (39 - x), (56 - x) and (107 - x) are in proportion

⇒ (22 - x) / (39 - x) = (56 - x) / (107 - x)

⇒ (22 - x)(107 -x) = (39 - x)(56 - x)

⇒ 2354 - 22x - 107x + x² = 2184 - 39x - 56x + x²

⇒ 2354 - 129x = 2184 - 95x

⇒ 34x = 170

⇒ x = 5

Mean proportion of (x + 3) and (3x - 7)

⇒ sqrt{(5 + 3)(15 - 7)} = sqrt{(8)(8)} = 8

**∴ The mean proportion of (x + 3) and (3x - 7) is 8.**

questions.question: In a cricket test match, Anuj completed his double century with 15 sixes and 18 fours. What percentage of runs did he make by running between the wickets to complete the double century?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Anuj completed a double century = 200 Runs

Total number of sixes = 15

Total number of four = 18

**Calculation:**

Total runs by sixes = 15 × 6 = 90

Total runs by four = 18 × 4 = 72

Total runs by sixes and fours = 90 + 72 = 162 runs 

Runs made by Anuj running between the wickets = 200 - 162 = 38

Percentage of runs made by Anuj running between the wickets

⇒ 38/200 × 100 = 19%

**∴ 19% of runs were made by Anuj running between the wickets.**

⇒ Runs % = 38/200 × 100 = 19%

**∴ 19% of runs were made by Anuj running between the wickets.**

questions.question: The average weight of the students in a class is 56 kg. If five more students whose average weight is 58 kg, join the class, the average weight of the students increases by 0.5 kg. What was the original number of students in the class?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the Alligation method on average weights:

Ratio of original to new students = (58 − 56.5) : (56.5 − 56) = 1.5 : 0.5 = 3 : 1

Given that 1 unit corresponds to 5 new students,

The original number of students (3 units) = 3 × 5 = 15.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average weight of original students = 56 kg

Number of new students = 5

Average weight of new students = 58 kg

Increase in average weight = 0.5 kg (New average = 56.5 kg)

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations

 Original (56)
 New (58)
 
 
 56.5
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 58 − 56.5 = 1.5
 56.5 − 56 = 0.5
 
 Ratio = 1.5 : 0.5 = 3 : 1

**Calculations:**

Let the original number of students be x.

⇒ Total weight of original students = 56x

⇒ Total weight of new students = 5 × 58 = 290 kg

⇒ Total number of students = x + 5

⇒ New average = (56x + 290) ÷ (x + 5)

⇒ 56.5 = (56x + 290) ÷ (x + 5)

⇒ 56.5 × (x + 5) = 56x + 290

⇒ 56.5x + 282.5 = 56x + 290

⇒ 56.5x − 56x = 290 − 282.5

⇒ 0.5x = 7.5

⇒ x = 7.5 ÷ 0.5 = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15 students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combined Average

When two groups of sizes n₁ and n₂ with averages A₁ and A₂ are mixed, the combined average is given by: A = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Alligation Method

It is a quick method to find the ratio of quantities in a mixture. The ratio of the quantity of group 1 to group 2 is (A₂ − Aₘᵢₓ) : (Aₘᵢₓ − A₁).

Deviation Method

The net change in an average is distributed equally among all observations. Net deviation = (New group average − Old average) × Number of new members.

questions.question: 4 men and 4 women can complete a work in 5 days, while 2 men and 5 women can finish it in 6 days. How much time (in days) will be taken by 1 woman working alone and 1 man working all by himself to complete the work, respectively?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

4 men and 4 women completed it in 5 days

2 men and 5 women completed it in 6 days

(4 Men + 4 Women) × 5 = (2 Men + 5 Women) × 6

⇒ 20 Men + 20 Women = 12 Men + 30 Women

⇒ 8 Men = 10 Women

⇒ Men : Women = 5 : 4

Total Work = (4 Men + 4 Women) × 5

⇒ Total Work = (4 × 5 + 4 × 4) × 5

⇒ Total Work = (20 + 16) × 5

⇒ Total Work = 180 units

Time required for one woman to complete work

⇒ 180/4 = 45 days

Time required for one man to complete work

⇒ 180/5 = 36 days

**∴ One woman and one man can complete the work in 45 days and 36 days respectively.**

questions.question: If two numbers are 12% and 48% of a third number, what percentage is the first number of the second number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First number is 12% of third number 

Second number is 48% of third number

**Calculation:**

Let the third number be 100.

⇒ First number = 100 × 12% = 12

⇒ Second number = 100 × 48% = 48

Required Percentage = (12/48) ×100 = 25%

**∴ The first number is 25% of the second number.**
